Indrabhūti
son of Brāhmaṇa Vasubhūti an. Brāhmaṇī Pṛthvī, born in the village of Gorbara in Magadha an. died a. Guṇava in Rājagṛha a. the age of 92 (in C. 515 B. C.). Disciple of Mahāvīra; codified the latter's teachings into 12 Aṅgas; also known a. Gautama or Gotama; the first Gaṇadhara (607 B. C.--515 B. C.). See Gotamastotra by Jinaprabhasūri; S. C. Vidyabhushana, HIL. p.. 159-160; Jain Anti. VI. ii. p. 76. Peters. III. App. p. 38. IV. Index of a.s. p. xiii. Weber II. p.. 983, 1030. Ind. Ant. XI. 1882. p. 246.
